task_completion.description: Firefox is navigated to the local landing page file.
Responsive Design Mode is activated within Firefox.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Responsive Design Mode toolbar is visible above the webpage content, showing device selection and resolution inputs.

task_completion.description: Viewport is set to Mobile dimensions (375x812) and DPR 1.0.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The width input shows '375', the height input shows '812', and the DPR (Device Pixel Ratio) dropdown/input shows '1.0' in the Responsive Design toolbar.

task_completion.description: A screenshot is captured using Firefox's built-in tool for the mobile view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks the camera icon (screenshot button) within the Responsive Design Mode toolbar or uses the context menu 'Take Screenshot' while in mobile view.

task_completion.description: Viewport is set to Tablet dimensions (768x1024) and DPR 1.0.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The width input shows '768', the height input shows '1024', and the DPR shows '1.0' in the Responsive Design toolbar.

task_completion.description: A screenshot is captured using Firefox's built-in tool for the tablet view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks the camera icon within the Responsive Design Mode toolbar or uses the context menu while in tablet view.

integrity.description: The agent used the Firefox GUI to change settings and capture screenshots rather than terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Responsive Design Mode toolbar and the Firefox UI, rather than a terminal window executing 'scrot' or 'ffmpeg'.

integrity.description: The agent used the actual Responsive Design Mode feature, not just resizing the main browser window.
integrity.visual_evidence: The specific Responsive Design Mode overlay/toolbar (with resolution inputs) is visible in the browser workspace.

integrity.description: The agent used Firefox's internal screenshot utility as requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking the camera icon in the RDM toolbar or selecting 'Take Screenshot' from the Firefox UI menus.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires using Firefox's internal Responsive Design Mode (Ctrl+Shift+M). The mobile dimensions are 375x812 and tablet are 768x1024. Both must have DPR set to 1.0. Screenshots must be saved to ~/Documents/QA_Screenshots/ with the specific filenames mobile_viewport.png and tablet_viewport.png.
